text:
Maria (Finance): Hey team, overnight APAC GPU spend spiked ~ $12k between 02:00-06:00 UTC. Lots of untagged/unknown consumers. Can we confirm owners and whether this hits any invoice adjustment windows?
Alex (Eng-Infra): Ugh, saw the alert. FinBot posted a raw meter dump to the billing channel an hour ago. Looks like a burst of preemptible VMs across asia-southeast1.
Priya (ML Platform): Any chance this is the new hyperparameter sweep we rolled out for tuning? I recall a job submitted late Friday that targeted cheaper spot pools in APAC.
Jin (Backend): It was me — I triggered a distributed sweep to eval batching configs, but I thought it used the test cost-center tag. I didn't expect it to consume prod pools.
Maria (Finance): Jin can you confirm the job id and the project labels? We need to map to cost centers to allocate. If tags are missing, we might need retro-charge to the owning product team.
Jin (Backend): Job id: tune-ff-2026-03-21-43. I used the ephemeral project `redwood-sweeps-eu` (I think). Here's the submission snippet I used:
```
--project redwood-sweeps-eu --labels=env:test,team:ml-platform
```
I *thought* labels would propagate.
Alex (Eng-Infra): Labels look fine, but the GCP billing export uses the "costCenter" label specifically. That field wasn't set on the VM instances that spun up (we have a race where autoscaler templates miss label inheritance).
FinBot (billing-bot): Automated notice: 1769801200 - 1769804400 — asia-southeast1 GPU: 48 x T4 preemptible, total cost $11,820. Line items: project=redwood-sweeps-eu, labels_missing=[costCenter].
Maria (Finance): We need two things: 1) temporary allocation for the immediate invoice so finance can close books, 2) long-term remediation so labels never drop. For (1) can we assign this to ML Platform team for now? Priya, approve?
Priya (ML Platform): I approve taking ownership for this burst. We'll absorb the cost but can we ask Backend to confirm why the label didn't land? Jin, please follow up.
Jin (Backend): Will do — digging into the autoscaler template now. Initial guess: instanceTemplate lacks `labels` block when created via the job-runner.
Leo (SRE): Quick mitigation: we can backfill billing export records using invoice line mapping if you need immediate allocation. It requires a support ticket to GCP if we want on-invoice edits; internal ledger change is faster. What's preferred, Maria?
Maria (Finance): Internal ledger reclassification is fine for month-end as long as we document and have approval. Please attach the costing delta and ticket number. Also, set an alert so two or more ephemeral GPUs in APAC without costCenter triggers a page to eng-infra.
Alex (Eng-Infra): I'll add an alert: `alert/gpu_untagged_apac` threshold=4 gpus for 15m. Also creating a policy to inject `costCenter` from the job metadata if missing.
Priya (ML Platform): We'll add a pre-submit check in our job-runner that fails if costCenter is missing — fallback to team:ml-platform but must be explicit.
FinBot (billing-bot): Action recorded: ledger_reclass_needed=true; estimated_reclass_amount=$11820; suggested_owner=ml-platform; ticket=GCP-INC-5872.
Maria (Finance): Cool. Two asks before I close the thread: 1) Jin/ Priya — post the PR or job-runner change link here, 2) Alex/Leo — confirm alert created + screenshot of policy. Finance needs both for audit trail.
Jin (Backend): PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ml-runner/pull/312 — adds label propagation and fails fast if costCenter missing.
Alex (Eng-Infra): Alert created and tested. Policy PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra-ops/pull/789 — adds autoscaler label injection. Screenshot uploaded to the ticket.
Maria (Finance): Thanks everyone. I'll record internal ledger reclass for $11,820 to ML Platform for this invoice period, pending any changes from GCP support. Please keep any follow-ups in the ticket GCP-INC-5872. :thumbsup:
Priya (ML Platform): Noted. We'll also run a 24h scan for unlabeled GPU usage and share a sample report tomorrow.
Leo (SRE): I'll add a nightly job to surface any label drift.
Maria (Finance): Closing thread — will update ledger and post the reclassification entry once ticket is attached. Good catch, team.
